subject: Hollow Pine Coffee — Content Experience build

indicators.note: No tag rows, status chips or decorative pills. The bag count is a state indicator and the band CTA is a pill-shaped button, not a content chip.
No italic text, and no italic face is requested from the font service.
Instrument Sans only. A fashionable display serif was rejected before implementation.

indicators.justification: Negative tracking is limited to display sizes: hero −0.025em, section headings −0.018em, wordmark −0.03em. The reference observation records large, tightly led display type. The exact value is estimated, not measured, and is never applied to body copy.
referenceEvidence: obs-type: "Display type is large and tightly led; body text stays small and quiet." (measured; ev-fellow-desktop, ev-bluebottle-desktop)

indicators.note: Three product cards, three brew steps, one split per band. No nested panels, toolbars or decorative controls.
Rules are limited to the raised header edge, the three ordered brew steps, the hero metadata row and the legal row. They express grouping, not rhythm.
Dark-surface text uses two token levels (--on-dark-muted, --on-dark-faint) plus --on-dark-line and --on-dark-border. No one-off opacity values remain for text.
Cards are filled fields without borders. The newsletter underline is a field boundary, not a container outline.
No diagrams, node graphs or flowcharts.
Copy stays at one or two short paragraphs per band. No paragraph restates its heading.
No file paths, component trails or step breadcrumbs.
Product cards carry no index numerals. The only 01–03 sequence is the brew method, where order is real.

indicators.pattern: Tracked-caps section labels above four content headings
indicators.justification: Four labels introduce the roast, craft, source and method bands. The reference records tracked caps as a section-label system. Each label names the band's role rather than repeating its heading, and the hero, band and close carry no eyebrow.
referenceEvidence: obs-type: "Blue Bottle uses tracked caps." (measured; ev-bluebottle-desktop)

indicators.note: No noise, dither or grain layers.
Radius is 2px on buttons and cards; the pill radius is used only on the band CTA and bag count.

indicators.pattern: Uppercase section labels, origin metadata and footer headings
indicators.justification: Uppercase is limited to the section labels, roast origin/process metadata and footer column headings. Both references use tracked caps for these roles; body copy, navigation and buttons remain sentence case.
referenceEvidence: obs-type: "Fellow uses sentence case; Blue Bottle uses tracked caps." (measured; ev-fellow-desktop, ev-bluebottle-desktop)

indicators.pattern: Linear-gradient scrims over the two photographic bands
indicators.justification: Two linear-gradient scrims sit on independent layers over the roast-day and close photographs. The reference records the same overlay kind, layer and direction on both images. The scrim protects text contrast; no atmospheric gradient appears on any flat section.
referenceEvidence: images.band-image.overlays: linear-gradient, independent layer, to top (estimated; ev-fellow-desktop)
images.close-image.overlays: linear-gradient, independent layer, to top (estimated; ev-bluebottle-desktop)

indicators.note: No heading or card title ends with a full stop. The close heading contains an internal stop between two sentences, not a decorative terminal period.
